# AeroX — Virtual Wind Tunnel for Cyclists
> AeroX is a desktop application that turns any smart trainer into a virtual wind tunnel. It measures a cyclist's frontal area (A) in real time using a webcam and computer vision — the part of aerodynamic drag (CdA = Cd × A) that the rider controls through their position — enabling position optimization without a physical wind tunnel.

## What AeroX does
AeroX is a virtual wind tunnel for indoor cyclists. The application uses artificial intelligence and computer vision to measure the cyclist's frontal area (A, in m²) in real time from a simple webcam pointed at a cyclist on a trainer. CdA = Cd × A: AeroX measures A, the component the rider controls through position; it does not measure the drag coefficient Cd. It calculates the aerodynamic impact of every position change instantly, giving cyclists and bike fitters actionable data to reduce drag and ride faster.

## Key metrics and results
- Frontal area (A) measurement in real time via webcam (no smart trainer required for position analysis)
- Repeatability: 3%
- Typical gains: +2 to 3 km/h at same power output (+2.3 km/h on average, measured)
- Power savings: 35 W at 30 km/h
- 300+ measurement sessions completed (2025–2026)
- Used by bike fitters on 3 continents (Brazil, USA, Europe)

## What is CdA?
CdA (Coefficient of Drag × Area) is the primary metric of aerodynamic efficiency in cycling. It is expressed in m² and represents the product of the drag coefficient (Cd) and the frontal area (A). Lower CdA means less aerodynamic resistance. Typical values: road cyclist 0.30–0.35 m², time trial position 0.20–0.25 m², professional TT 0.18–0.22 m².

## Technical specifications
- Platforms: macOS and Windows (desktop application)
- Connectivity: Bluetooth FTMS (smart trainer protocol)
- Compatible trainers: Wahoo Kickr, Elite Direto, Tacx Neo, Saris H3, and any Bluetooth FTMS trainer
- Compatible sensors: Garmin, Polar, Suunto (heart rate, cadence)
- Camera: any standard webcam (built-in or external)
- AI engine: real-time computer vision for frontal area measurement

## Use cases
1. **Self-optimization**: Cyclists test position changes at home on their trainer and measure the frontal-area impact instantly
2. **Bike fitting**: Professional bike fitters use AeroX during fitting sessions to quantify aerodynamic gains of each adjustment
3. **Race simulation**: Import a GPX course profile and simulate race performance with current aerodynamic data
4. **Time trial ranking**: Compare aerodynamic efficiency against other users on standardized courses

## Target users
- Competitive road cyclists and triathletes seeking aerodynamic gains
- Time trial specialists optimizing their TT position
- Professional bike fitters adding aerodynamic measurement to their services
- Cycling coaches integrating aero data into training plans

## Offers and availability
- **AeroX Diagnostic** (cyclists and triathletes): one-time purchase, no subscription. 2 sessions in the desktop app: compare up to 10 positions live, then hold the best one for at least 20 minutes; you get your recommended position and your time and speed gains. 30 days to complete it; results stay viewable. Available in the app from 1 November 2026 (pre-order before). Launch price €49 instead of €79 until 15 November 2026, then €79. Fully refunded as long as no session has been done, including if your equipment is not compatible.
- **Bike fitter plans** (prices excl. VAT): Essential €20/month + €15 per analysis; Unlimited €99/month or €990/year. 14-day free trial on every plan. Launch offer for the first 20 studios: Unlimited at €69/month until 31 December 2026, or €690 for the first year. Plans available from 1 November 2026.
- Requirements: a Mac or Windows computer, a webcam and the bike on a trainer; a Bluetooth FTMS smart trainer is only needed for the Power and Speed modes.
- Available on macOS and Windows
